descriptor.name: San Joaquin County / Stockton Assessor parcels
descriptor.attribution: San Jouquin County CD/GIS & City of Stockton IT/GIS; Data Steward: San Joaquin County Assessor's Office

evidence: The frozen city packet identifies San Joaquin County Assessor parcel mapping and the Diesel_WFL1 Parcels layer, with County CD/GIS and City of Stockton IT/GIS attribution and County Assessor stewardship.

Live first-party layer metadata describes APN_CHR as the Assessor Parcel Number text with leading zeros and POLY_CODE classes as condominium, assessed, unassessed or government parcels; this establishes assessment parcel purpose rather than an inference from the layer name.

The layer's EPSG:3857 extent covers the frozen Stockton point; both the frozen sample and an independent anonymous safe-field point query at [-121.30363247299,37.9838255374783] return APN_CHR 11512305. This establishes local Stockton scope, not citywide completeness.

The official County Assessor parcel-maps page confirms online Assessor parcel maps and links GIS parcel information: https://www.sjgov.org/department/assessor/property-information/homeowners/parcel-maps
